He's making clear that everything must stay rooted in our established laws, time-honored cultural traditions, and the shared values of our own people rather than outside agendas. Amid these so-called global human rights talks, which are really just progressive tools meant to weaken national authority, traditional order, and the family, he's renewing his pledge to the rule of law.
